runtimes.concurrency: One isolated Lean runtime per browser realm; the threaded profile additionally requires cross-origin isolation and SharedArrayBuffer.
runtimes.filesystem: Packaged WebAssembly and component bytes are read-only; no ambient host filesystem is exposed.
runtimes.network: Network access is required only to retrieve application-owned package assets; generated bindings perform no network calls.
runtimes.lifecycle: Owned resources close explicitly; finalization is fallback-only and the realm owns runtime shutdown.

runtimes.concurrency: One process-wide Lean runtime; callbacks execute on the initiating runtime thread.
runtimes.filesystem: The loader reads packaged shared libraries from the verified installation root and writes no runtime state there.
runtimes.network: No network access is required after package installation.
runtimes.lifecycle: The host initializes once, closes owned resources deterministically, and retains the runtime until process exit.

runtimes.concurrency: One process-wide runtime per Node worker isolate; objects never cross isolates.
runtimes.filesystem: The package reads only its verified runtime payload and an explicitly configured cache root.
runtimes.network: No network access is required after npm installation.
runtimes.lifecycle: Explicit close is authoritative; FinalizationRegistry is a leak fallback and process exit owns runtime teardown.

runtimes.concurrency: One process-owned Lean runtime in the non-thread-safe PHP profile; callbacks remain on the request thread.
runtimes.filesystem: PHP loads the packaged extension and shared libraries without compiling or mutating the package.
runtimes.network: No network access is required after Composer installation.
runtimes.lifecycle: Request objects close deterministically and module shutdown releases process-owned adapter state.

runtimes.concurrency: One Node-hosted PHP-Wasm runtime per isolate using either the reviewed lazy or startup loading profile.
runtimes.filesystem: The virtual filesystem contains immutable packaged extension and component assets.
runtimes.network: No network access is required after the host package and side modules are present.
runtimes.lifecycle: The PHP host closes projected resources before the containing Node isolate exits.

runtimes.concurrency: One process-wide Lean runtime; generated calls and callbacks execute while the initiating Python thread owns the adapter call.
runtimes.filesystem: The adapter loads only wheel-owned shared libraries and does not compile during installation.
runtimes.network: No network access is required after wheel installation.
runtimes.lifecycle: Context managers and explicit close are authoritative; interpreter shutdown is not used for semantic work.

exclusions: musl and glibc older than 2.38 for native payloads
Unreviewed browser, Node, PHP, Python, compiler, linker, or registry versions

enforcement.releaseAuthorization: Publication remains blocked unless this exact profile revision is reviewed and all external production evidence is independently confirmed.
